entities.summary: Abdul Rehman is a Pakistani boxer. He competed in the men's heavyweight event at the 1964 Summer Olympics. At the 1964 Summer Olympics, after receiving a bye in the Round of 16, he lost to Hans Huber of the United Team of Germany in a quarterfinal.
